admissionGates.rule: Every projected region must be backed by multiple normalized external ReferenceIdentities or one strongly coherent identity plus externally supported internal topology. No internal Ordivon theory may satisfy this gate.
Removing the region projection must create material repeated navigation/recovery/exploration loss that cannot be repaired cheaply by neighboring regions plus explicit bridges/axes.
The projection must have an intelligible scope/firewall and avoid mixing arbitrary unrelated fields merely for balance or institutional symmetry.
The region must preserve multi-placement and cross-cutting BRIDGE/AXIS/INFRASTRUCTURE identities; admission must not force exclusive parentage.
The region must not create or override external reference identity, owner truth, Foundation standing, closure, or currentness.
Admission is bounded/versioned navigation convenience and never claims exhaustive foundational-space closure.
The region should remain useful under plausible addition/removal/reclassification of subspaces; it must not depend on one fragile institutional taxonomy.

coreDistinction.CanonicalMajorRegion: A generated, stable navigation projection over ReferenceIdentities/relations/archetypes for human and Agent exploration.
coreDistinction.ReferenceIdentity: An externally evidenced coordinate/identity in the exploration graph.

negativeCriteria: Independent university department or degree program is insufficient.
Professional society or funding division is insufficient.
High publication volume or historical age is insufficient.
Being deep, useful, measurable or important is insufficient.
Being a BRIDGE/AXIS/INFRASTRUCTURE alone does not require a major-region projection.
A coherent field with zero primitives is not disqualified.
A field being derived or subordinate does not make it unreal or unworthy of explicit identity.

projectionShape.anchorRefs: Optional high-salience ReferenceIdentity refs; anchor != semantic root
projectionShape.crossCuttingRefs: BRIDGE/AXIS/INFRASTRUCTURE refs displayed across region boundaries
projectionShape.label: Human-facing navigation label
projectionShape.sourceBasisRefs: External reference evidence/provenance that supports member identities, not authority for the projection itself
